Three concrete failures: (1) tests/test_claude_md_section_numbers.py resolves the symlink to verify section-number stability and will fail with a missing-file error; (2) tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py reads this file to verify guard hook template parity and will fail; (3) on the next consumer sync, update_workflows.yml will either delete the consumer's CLAUDE.md or error on a missing source.

Tests that resolve this symlink path will fail because the symlink target exists (../CLAUDE.md) but the symlink itself does not. The consumer sync workflow copies workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md into consumer repos; with the symlink missing, the copy either skips (leaving a stale consumer copy) or throws an error.
